review.intent_summary: Calibrated point-threshold crossings become inspectable observations, with adjacent crossings grouped into episodes.

criteria.criterion: A sufficiently extreme calibrated sample records a point trigger and the expectation it departed from.
Repeated runs of the same fixed request preserve numerical evidence; future samples do not change earlier scoring for declared settings.
Adjacent point departures form a consecutive-run pattern with the contributing sample positions.
Separated point departures remain separate episodes, and positional episode intervals use integer coordinates.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected spike: one episode at sample 65, original observed value retained, and overlapping CUSUM/moving-range findings interpreted separately.
